_comment: Read by backend/tests/test_reminders.py and countdown.test.ts next door. It sits inside frontend/src rather than in a shared/ directory at the repository root because the frontend image builds with frontend/ as its context: anything outside is invisible to `npm run build`, and the build fails. The backend only reads it from its tests, which run from the repository. Each case now carries both languages: the countdown is prose, and was hard-coded French until someone noticed an English installation saying J-406.
